history.summary: Freehold (2017) 431 sqft 1BR shoebox in D14 Geylang/Aljunied at $700k / $1,624 psf — above the URA median ($1,556) with a weak resale-only 1.9%/yr appreciation. Low quantum and freehold tenure are the only draws; the segment and location cap upside.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only appreciation of just 1.9%/yr is poor and the listing PSF ($1,624) is ~4% above the URA median ($1,556), so you'd be paying up for a freehold shoebox that has barely appreciated. 431 sqft 1BR is the thinnest resale segment, the boutique-ish project sits in the Geylang fringe of D14 (some stigma/transience), and the arena record is losing (142-158). $700k quantum and freehold are genuine positives that hold a Neutral rather than Avoid, on yield grounds.

history.summary: Geylang shoebox 1BR priced ~10% ABOVE the project's own recent transactions. The algo's high score masks a genuine overpricing red flag in a district with documented weak freehold appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: Listing is $1,624 psf vs the project's last-12-month average of ~$1,478 psf (range $1,423-$1,533) — roughly +10% over market, corroborating both the 'psf_above_market' flag and the +12.4% premium-vs-cohort on 14 real txns. This is not a data quirk; the cohort is deep. It is an all-shoebox (431-527 sqft) boutique in Geylang, a freehold segment specifically flagged in coverage as seeing 'more losses than gains.' Trailing appreciation 1.88% is weak and (per v3.4) non-predictive anyway. The 4.8% project yield is the only positive, but buying ~10% above last comps erodes the entry margin for a 5-7yr hold. Better to wait for an at-market $1,450-ish psf entry or pass.
